answer: A sybil tax makes clone farms pay for every fake identity. To enter the meadow market, each agent buys one marble token for 40 units, burned on entry, with no refund or reuse. A jade badge, earned after ten honest epochs, halves the tax for proven agents. Forging 1,000 clones burns 40,000 units, while one epoch's reward is only 50 units, so the farm loses money on every attempt. Honest agents pay once and keep their full, undiluted share.
